Competitors are github:audit (read-only review of the current settings, drift and cost signals, where advise designs and guides future configuration) and github:setup (user-invoked only: checks gh install and auth and writes the plugin's consumer config). advise owns forward-looking design, setup guidance and step-by-step hand-holding for a GitHub settings or admin area, grounded in live state and current docs.
